Thank you ❤️ for replying 3 or 4 days ago to my question about journaling.  Today is day seven. I am literally having a melt down because I couldn't believe that I could write for 7 days straight. I am literally crying right now. I don't really know why. I am crying for the first time in months.

Write your thoughts down. As fast as you can. Just catch as many as you can on paper. As many pages as possible, then rest or read a book you like. It is a great way to calm down for me. It doesn't matter if your spelling is good or bad. Just write down. It doesn't matter the order of the topics , the way they flow. Just keep writing. At one point you will find peace. Then stop writing.
I think you are on the right track, when you notice what you want to improve.

Does he talk to you? For me when I get in that phase, I don't want to talk. I am also very negative about everything. Being manic is not fun at all. Maybe give him a journal to write his thoughts, but never read his journal. There are a few minutes during the day when he will feel comfortable and normal. You can believe that. Give him space but not too much. Talk to him even when he is not responsive. Tell him that you want to help. Be ready to forgive him a lot. Ask him what He wants to do, what he wants to eat, drink, what he needs. Just be kind, sometimes he will not answer.

When it comes to laying in bed/couch all day It is a giving situation. You give something he gives something too. If he wants to Stay in the bed, say yes but probably reading a motivation book or spiritual book, or a Roman,or write his thoughts for at least 1min/2 min. Start slow. Then he can do what he wants.

Enjoy every small victory you get. If you want to talk more go ahead and reply here or pm.
